Downtown Modesto.name: Downtown Modesto
Downtown Modesto.description: Tenth Street Plaza core with the Gallo Center for the Arts, facade-rehab permitting, adaptive reuse of the historic commercial grid, and the city's densest business-license churn.

Virginia Corridor South.name: Virginia Corridor South
Virginia Corridor South.description: Mid-century belt along the Virginia Corridor greenway with renovation-led permitting and small-office conversions.

Graceada Park Historic District.name: Graceada Park Historic District
Graceada Park Historic District.description: Graceada Park, the McHenry Mansion and Museum district, and the city's finest century-old housing stock with restoration-grade permit cadence.

Modesto Junior College East.name: Modesto Junior College East
Modesto Junior College East.description: MJC east-campus rental belt with steady tenant turnover, duplex conversions, and college-service licensing.

College & El Vista.name: College & El Vista
College & El Vista.description: El Vista Avenue corridor of post-war tracts with basement-finish and roof-permit cadence.

La Loma.name: La Loma
La Loma.description: East-side grid around La Loma Park with owner-occupied vintage housing and incremental renovation permitting.

Village One.name: Village One
Village One.description: One of Modesto's largest planned-unit developments — curvilinear 1970s-80s housing with steady remodel volume and neighborhood-retail licensing.

Sherwood Forest & Sylvan.name: Sherwood Forest & Sylvan
Sherwood Forest & Sylvan.description: Sylvan Avenue retail spine beside Sherwood Forest Park with pool/deck auxiliary permits and small-business churn.

Kiernan Business Corridor.name: Kiernan Business Corridor
Kiernan Business Corridor.description: Kiernan Avenue northeast growth corridor with new-build retail and medical pads, UC Merced-adjacent logistics, and the metro's fastest permit velocity.

Pelandale Corridor.name: Pelandale Corridor
Pelandale Corridor.description: Pelandale Avenue big-box and dining row with pad-site filings and highway-99-adjacent service licensing.

Airport Neighborhood.name: Airport Neighborhood
Airport Neighborhood.description: Housing south of the Modesto City-County Airport with industrial-adjacent infill and steady alteration permitting.

West Modesto & Beard Industrial Edge.name: West Modesto & Beard Industrial Edge
West Modesto & Beard Industrial Edge.description: Highway 99 frontage against the Beard Industrial District with warehouse conversions and trade licensing volume.

Rosemount & Scenic.name: Rosemount & Scenic
Rosemount & Scenic.description: Scenic Drive heights above the Oakdale Road retail spine with ranch-scale lots and remodel-led permitting.
